sentence: This project tries to find out which genes shared across five plant species control how plants gather elements.
This project builds statistical methods that let hospitals study spatial genomics data together without sharing sensitive patient information.
This project builds learning methods that give reliable uncertainty estimates for predictions when data comes from different sources and changes over time.
This project builds a method that explains why systems that identify cyberattacks on computer networks flag certain activities as threats.
This project works on ways to make medical devices that cause less material waste and fewer carbon emissions.
This project builds a way to watch how tightly DNA is packed inside live cells without using external markers.
This project studies what protein language models learn about the structural, functional and evolutionary organization of proteins.
This project brings together universities, industry partners and research institutions to develop a foundational curriculum on quantum computing.
This project studies how retinal ganglion cells in a Xenopus tadpole's eye connect to the ventral midbrain and what that connection does for vision.
This project builds mathematical and computational methods that make simulations of quantum materials more reliable.
This project studies how a protein complex protects cell identity in Caenorhabditis elegans.
This project builds reusable software pieces that help scientists and engineers use future fault-tolerant quantum computers for modeling, simulation and optimization.
This project studies how genes and proteins shape the way silk fibers work in caddisflies and moths.
This project organizes a meeting where researchers share work on how humans and intelligent engineered systems interact.
This project builds tools to combine ecological data and to check how reliable the patterns seen over time are.
This project studies how annealing changes the structure and properties of metal matrix composites made by additive manufacturing.
This project studies how cellulose nanocrystals affect immune responses and how cells take them up.
This project builds a sensor that uses nanomaterials to monitor immune responses continuously.
